procedure_text: 将40g  2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.6％、0.152mol)，200ml二氯乙烷，1g偶氮二异丁腈(99％、0.006mol)，46g氢溴酸(48％、0.273mol)加入500ml反应瓶中，在75～80℃滴加20.6g双氧水(30％、0.182mol)，滴加完毕后继续反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后分层，有机层水洗、浓缩，异丙醇进行重结晶、过滤、烘干得46.67g白色粉末，纯度99.0％，收率89％。
procedure_summary: The benzylic methyl group of the methyl benzoate is brominated with hydrobromic acid and hydrogen peroxide in dichloroethane, initiated by azobisisobutyronitrile, with the peroxide added dropwise to the hot mixture. The layers are separated, the organic layer is washed with water and concentrated, and the product is recrystallised from isopropanol, filtered and dried to a white powder.
notes: Chinese heading 1、2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成. Benzylic bromination of the ring methyl group, run on the hydrobromic acid plus hydrogen peroxide system rather than on molecular bromine or an N-bromo reagent, with azobisisobutyronitrile as the radical initiator, hence mechanism_type radical. named_reaction is left null deliberately: Wohl-Ziegler names a bromination by an N-bromo reagent such as N-bromosuccinimide, and no N-bromo reagent is charged here, so applying that name would be a stretch. catalyst_class is tagged none because the initiator is an azo radical initiator and the tag vocabulary offers no value for it; azobisisobutyronitrile is recorded on the compound list with role catalyst to match A1. TEMPERATURE: the only temperature printed in this step is 75 to 80 degrees C, and the Chinese attaches it to the dropwise peroxide addition (在75～80℃滴加20.6g双氧水), not to a reaction hold. It is therefore recorded in the hydrogen peroxide addition_profile and conditions.temperature is left not_specified; the text says only 滴加完毕后继续反应 after the addition and never restates a temperature. Elsewhere in this example the document does distinguish the two, writing 进行反应 with a range where it means a reaction temperature (step 2) and 滴加 with a range where it means an addition temperature (steps 1 and 3), so the distinction is the document's own. NO REACTION TIME is given anywhere in this step, or indeed anywhere in this example; LC跟踪至反应完全 is in-process control and is recorded in process_control, not in time_h. Reactor is a 500 ml reaction flask (500ml反应瓶); the Chinese does not say four-necked and names no stirrer, thermometer or condenser, so stirring is left null. The 48％ on the hydrobromic acid and the 30％ on the hydrogen peroxide are printed in the same parenthesis the section uses for purity, but they are aqueous solution strengths; they are recorded as printed in each compound's purity_pct, following A1, and conditions.concentration is left null because the Chinese does not word either reagent as a solution the way rule 9's example does. ARITHMETIC: every mass, purity and mole triple in this step closes. 40 g at 99.6％ is 39.84 g, which over C10H11ClO4S at 262.71 is 0.1517 mol against the printed 0.152; azobisisobutyronitrile 0.99 g over 164.21 is 0.00603 against 0.006; hydrobromic acid 46 g at 48％ is 22.08 g over 80.91, 0.2729 against 0.273; hydrogen peroxide 20.6 g at 30％ is 6.18 g over 34.01, 0.1817 against 0.182. Product closure also holds: 0.152 mol at the drawn product's 341.60 gives 51.92 g theoretical, and the printed 46.67 g at 99.0％ purity is 46.20 g, which is 88.98％ of theory against the printed 89％. No mass_balance_implausible and no molar_mass_inconsistent is raised, and none was assumed. The structure drawn at line 178, COC(=O)c1ccc(S(C)(=O)=O)c(CBr)c1Cl, C10H10BrClO4S, is a single-molecule span, not a scheme, and it matches the product named in the heading, so no drawing_text_conflict. A0 estimated 3 steps and this section yields 3; there is no disagreement to explain.

procedure_text: 将30g  2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.0％、0.0869mol)，18g碳酸钾(99％、0.1289mol)，0.9g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.0079mol)，200ml四氢呋喃，10.5g  2,2,2-三氟乙醇(99％、0.1039mol)加入500ml反应瓶中，在75～80℃进行反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完毕后过滤，滤液浓缩。往剩余物里6g氢氧化钠(99％、0.1485mol)，200ml水，在70～75℃进行碱解，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后滴加盐酸酸化，过滤，洗涤，烘干得27.6g白色粉末，纯度99.7％，收率91.3％。
procedure_summary: The benzylic bromide is etherified with trifluoroethanol over potassium carbonate and a triethylenediamine catalyst in tetrahydrofuran, and the inorganic solids are filtered off and the filtrate concentrated. Without isolating the ether, the methyl ester is hydrolysed with aqueous sodium hydroxide and the hydrolysate acidified dropwise with hydrochloric acid, and the precipitated acid is filtered, washed and dried to a white powder.
notes: Chinese heading 2、2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成. ONE-POT, AND THE FIRST OF THE TWO IN THIS EXAMPLE. One numbered step, three operations in the same flask with no isolation between them: etherification of the benzylic bromide with trifluoroethanol at 75 to 80 degrees C, then, after only a filtration of the inorganic solids and a concentration of the filtrate, alkaline hydrolysis (碱解) of the methyl ester with sodium hydroxide and water at 70 to 75 degrees C, then dropwise acidification with hydrochloric acid. The intermediate ether is neither named nor assigned an amount by the text, so no compound record is emitted for it and no a1_missing_compound is raised; inventing an identifier for a species the patent never names would be a fabrication, not a recall fix. reaction_class follows the FINAL transformation and is therefore hydrolysis, with the acidification treated as the isolation half of that same ester-to-acid conversion rather than as a fourth class; it is listed in one_pot_steps in document order and also recorded in ph_target_stage and in the workup. named_reaction records Williamson ether synthesis, which names the first transformation, because the saponification carries no canonical name. CONDITIONS FOLLOW THE FINAL TRANSFORMATION: temperature is the 70 to 75 degrees C range of the 碱解, and the etherification's own 75 to 80 degrees C is stated here and in one_pot_steps rather than in the temperature field. Both ranges are written 进行反应 and 进行碱解, that is as reaction holds, unlike the 滴加 ranges in steps 1 and 3. No reaction time is given for either transformation; LC跟踪至反应完全 is stated twice, once for each, and is recorded in process_control. Reactor is a 500 ml reaction flask; no stirrer, thermometer or condenser is named. The final 洗涤 does not say what the cake was washed with, so workup.washes is left null and the operation is kept as a phrase in workup.steps rather than being read as a water wash. The isolation sentence is split by a page break, printed as ...烘干得27.6g白色 at the foot of one page and 粉末，纯度99.7％，收率91.3％。 at the head of the next; procedure_text joins the two halves and drops the page-break comment and the editorial continuation marker, which are not patent text. ARITHMETIC: every triple closes. Substrate 30 g at 99.0％ is 29.7 g, which over C10H10BrClO4S at 341.60 is 0.08694 mol against the printed 0.0869; potassium carbonate 17.82 g over 138.21 is 0.1289; triethylenediamine 0.891 g over 112.18 is 0.00794 against 0.0079; trifluoroethanol 10.395 g over 100.04 is 0.1039; sodium hydroxide 5.94 g over 40.00 is 0.1485 exactly. Product closure holds: 0.0869 mol at the drawn acid's 346.70 gives 30.13 g theoretical, and the printed 27.6 g at 99.7％ is 27.52 g, which is 91.33％ of theory against the printed 91.3％. Continuity holds too: step 1 isolated 46.67 g and this step charges 30 g of it, a subset, so no scale_discontinuity. No flag is raised on this step. The structure drawn at line 185, CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)O)c(Cl)c1COCC(F)(F)F, C11H10ClF3O5S, is a single-molecule span; it is drawn as the free carboxylic ACID, which corroborates the prose that the ester is hydrolysed in the same pot, and it matches the heading name, so no drawing_text_conflict.

procedure_text: 将27.4g  2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸(99.7％、0.0788mol)，0.2g  DMF(99％、0.0027mol)，12.3g氯化亚砜(99％、0.102mol)，100ml二氯乙烷加入250ml反应瓶中，升温回流反应，反应完毕后脱尽溶剂。将9.5g  1,3-环己二酮(99％、0.084mol)、100ml二氯乙烷加入反应瓶，在25～30℃滴加18.5g三乙胺(99％、0.18mol)，LC跟踪至反应完全。反应完全后，加入1g丙酮氰醇(95％、0.011mol)，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后加入水进行水洗，分层，油层脱尽溶剂，加甲醇进行重结晶，过滤，烘干得30.3g米黄色结晶粉末，纯度98.6％，收率86％。
procedure_summary: The benzoic acid is converted to its acid chloride with thionyl chloride and catalytic dimethylformamide in dichloroethane at reflux, and the solvent is then stripped off completely. Cyclohexanedione and fresh solvent are charged, triethylamine is added dropwise in the cold, and acetone cyanohydrin is then added to carry the mixture through to the aroyl dione, which is isolated by water washing, solvent removal and recrystallisation from methanol as a beige crystalline powder.
notes: Chinese heading 3、环磺酮的合成. ONE-POT, AND THE SECOND OF THE TWO IN THIS EXAMPLE. One numbered step, three sequential transformations with no isolation and no aqueous workup between them: acid chloride formation with thionyl chloride and catalytic DMF at reflux, then, after only a complete strip of the solvent and a fresh charge of dichloroethane, acylation of 1,3-cyclohexanedione with triethylamine added dropwise at 25 to 30 degrees C, then addition of acetone cyanohydrin and further reaction to the product. reaction_class follows the FINAL transformation. The product drawn at line 197 is the C-acylated 2-aroylcyclohexane-1,3-dione, so the net transformation of the step is an acylation of the dione and reaction_class is acylation; transformation:rearrangement is tagged as well because acetone cyanohydrin is charged separately, after the acylation had already been followed to completion by LC, which is the signature of the O-acyl to C-acyl migration. That reading is an inference from the drawn product and from the separate charge, NOT a statement of the text: the patent never names an intermediate between the acid chloride and tembotrione, and no enol ester is drawn, so no compound record is emitted for one. named_reaction is null; no widely accepted name covers a thionyl chloride activation followed by dione acylation and cyanohydrin-promoted migration, and stretching for one would be wrong. CONDITIONS: heating_method reflux is recorded, and it belongs to the FIRST transformation (升温回流反应); per rule 9 reflux is a heating method and not a temperature, and no number accompanies it. conditions.temperature is left not_specified because the only numeric range in the step, 25 to 30 degrees C, is attached to the dropwise triethylamine addition (在25～30℃滴加) and is recorded in that compound's addition_profile; the final transformation, the acetone cyanohydrin stage, is given no temperature at all. No reaction time is given for any of the three transformations; LC跟踪至反应完全 appears twice and is recorded in process_control. Reactor is a 250 ml reaction flask, smaller than the 500 ml used in steps 1 and 2; no stirrer, thermometer or condenser is named. Dichloroethane is charged twice, 100 ml and then a further 100 ml, and the compound record carries the first volume with both charges described in its addition_profile, matching A1's treatment. safety:cyanide_handling is tagged from the identity of acetone cyanohydrin, which is the only cyanide-releasing reagent in the example; safety_notes is left empty because the text makes no safety statement of its own and rule 15 forbids adding one. ARITHMETIC: every triple closes. Substrate 27.4 g at 99.7％ is 27.32 g, which over C11H10ClF3O5S at 346.70 is 0.07879 mol against the printed 0.0788; DMF 0.198 g over 73.09 is 0.00271 against 0.0027; thionyl chloride 12.177 g over 118.97 is 0.1024 against 0.102; 1,3-cyclohexanedione 9.405 g over 112.13 is 0.0839 against 0.084; triethylamine 18.315 g over 101.19 is 0.1810 against the printed 0.18; acetone cyanohydrin 0.95 g over 85.11 is 0.01116 against 0.011. Product closure holds against the limiting acid: 0.0788 mol at tembotrione's 440.82 gives 34.74 g theoretical, and the printed 30.3 g at 98.6％ is 29.88 g, which is 86.01％ of theory against the printed 86％. Continuity holds: step 2 isolated 27.6 g and this step charges 27.4 g of it, a subset, so no scale_discontinuity. No flag is raised on this step. The structure drawn at line 197, CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)C2C(=O)CCCC2=O)c(Cl)c1COCC(F)(F)F, C17H16ClF3O6S, is a single-molecule span and is the decisive evidence for the step: it is the C-acylated dione and not the O-acyl enol ester, which is what identifies the final transformation and confirms 环磺酮 as tembotrione. Drawing and prose agree, so no drawing_text_conflict.
